matching_rule: Exactly one specification per planned document ID; no extras.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Controlled cover, version record, persons, non-operative charges, collision chronology, issue map and procedural actions; neutral orientation without deciding dangerousness, distraction or causation.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 14-20 pages; 300-500 words per narrative page or 10-22 sourced events/rows per table page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital accessible PDF with searchable text, stable source links and repeated controlled headers.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unresolved time offsets and later corrected event links retained through dated versions.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Open orientation excludes privileged advice, irrelevant victim data and restricted device content; audience variants follow recorded permissions.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No copied witness/report prose, repeated chronology, generic offence summaries or blank padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Incident response records, signed witness and responder statements, scene photographs, dashcam/CCTV register, transcripts and continuity; preserves observations separately from reconstruction.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 28-40 pages; statements 250-450 words/page, registers 8-22 rows/page, and 1-4 necessary labelled images/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed signed statement scans, native video retained externally, lossless evidential stills and born-digital media/continuity registers.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Witness uncertainty, obstructed view, camera-clock drift and corrected exhibit labels allowed with explicit history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Bystander contact and irrelevant imagery minimised; only served material reaches defence/client/court; masters restricted to authorised handlers.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No near-identical still sequences, repeated statements, decorative scene images or transcript/media duplication.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Collision-investigation survey and reconstruction: instructions, qualifications, scene measurements, assumptions, calculations, plans, uncertainty, opinion and addendum; tests speed, visibility and braking without determining the legal standard.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 35-48 pages; narrative 250-450 words/page, calculation tables 6-16 rows/page, and only evidentially necessary diagrams/plans.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital report with vector plans and selectable tables; signed declaration page may be scanned; native calculation files referenced and hashed.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Measurement tolerance, incomplete sight-line datum and corrected calculation permitted; original report remains visible beside addendum.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Expert drafts and privileged instructions restricted; signed/served report distributed according to service and ruling state.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated diagrams, unexplained precision, ornamental equations, duplicated methodology or artificial appendices.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Vehicle seizure/retention, inspection, brake and mechanical testing, EDR/ECU acquisition, decoded output, expert reports and addenda; separates physical defect, data state, knowledge and inference.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 30-42 pages; inspection narrative 250-450 words/page, test/download tables 8-20 rows/page and 1-3 diagnostic images/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed custody scans, born-digital inspection report, native binary download retained by hash and safe decoded tables; photographs retain metadata.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Unsupported parameter, firmware mismatch, post-collision damage ambiguity and repeat test allowed with version trail.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Native downloads and personal vehicle data limited to authorised experts/parties; served extracts reflect order and relevance.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No invented parameters, repetitive component photos, raw hex page dumps, duplicated custody records or unsupported defect conclusions.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Provider and extraction statements, phone/navigation attribution records, native CSV/XLSX telematics schedules, journey/event mapping and methodology; supplies timing and device state without equating activity with driver use.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 28-40 rendered-equivalent pages; spreadsheets 15-35 substantive rows/view, concise methodology, and limited plotted views with source rows.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native CSV/XLSX and provider exports are primary; formulas/filters/hidden rows declared; readable PDF previews are non-authoritative; no macro execution.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Clock drift, null fields, duplicate pings, coverage gaps and corrected timezone interpretation retained transparently.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Irrelevant location/communications and third-party data minimised; native data restricted; client/court receive authorised schedules or extracts.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No screenshot-only tables, repeated rows, unlabelled filtering, invented interpolation, chart decoration or formula-driven padding.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Emergency treatment records, post-mortem materials, pathology report and addendum with instructions, findings, medical cause and limitations; excludes autonomous legal-causation conclusions.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 22-32 pages; clinical entries retain authentic density, reports 250-450 words/page and images appear only when necessary and controlled.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Mixed certified clinical extracts/scans and born-digital signed expert report; restricted images separately indexed and hashed.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Contemporaneous abbreviation, amended clinical entry and expert addendum permitted with audit/source history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Health and post-mortem material is need-to-know; sensitive images excluded from client/general exports unless authorised; served report follows ruling state.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No wholesale unrelated medical history, repeated observations, decorative anatomy, copied generic pathology text or invented legal conclusion.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Authoritative road geometry, signal-controller logs, traffic orders, lighting/weather observations, survey maps and mapping reconciliation; establishes environmental records with source hierarchy.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; logs 12-30 rows/page, orders/plans at authentic density, and maps only at scales that preserve legibility.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Native controller CSV/logs and GIS/vector outputs where available; certified order scans; born-digital reconciled map with source layers identified.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Controller reset, missing log interval, revised map layer and superseded traffic order allowed with explicit status.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Public/order material broadly shareable; infrastructure-sensitive or personal location detail restricted as recorded.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated maps at trivial scales, unexplained route overlays, generic weather pages, duplicate log dumps or irrelevant orders.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Custody/interview record, audio/transcript completeness, defence position, prosecution admissions request, maker response, signed admissions and agreed-facts schedule; preserves each lifecycle and binding scope.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 20-30 pages; interview transcript 300-550 words/page, forms at authentic density and admissions tables 6-16 propositions/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Signed custody/form scans, native interview audio retained by hash, searchable transcript and born-digital admissions/agreed-facts schedules.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Transcript inaudible marker, corrected speaker label, qualified admission and amended agreed-fact draft allowed with history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privileged advice excluded; interview and signed/served positions shared only as authorised; draft defence material remains privileged.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No repeated interview text, invented answers, unsigned propositions presented as agreed, generic defence prose or duplicate schedules.

specifications.expected_professional_structure_and_purp: Disclosure records, expert directions and joint statement, hearing chronology, bail/order states, plea and sentencing materials, deadline tracker and later-stage outcomes; provides procedural control without predicting decisions.
specifications.realistic_page_range_and_information_den: 28-40 pages; schedules 10-24 rows/page, orders/forms at authentic density and submissions 250-500 words/page.
specifications.native_scan_or_media_characteristics: Born-digital trackers/schedules and signed or sealed court/expert records; superseded orders retained and visibly watermarked as such.
specifications.legitimate_imperfections_and_version_his: Late item, amended direction, adjournment, varied bail and corrected deadline allowed with complete state history.
specifications.confidentiality_redaction_and_audience_r: Privileged submissions/advice restricted; court/CPS/client receive only filed, served or authorised versions; personal sentencing data minimised.
specifications.prohibited_filler_duplication_and_paddin: No duplicate orders, generic sentencing essays, repeated schedules, speculative hearing outcomes or artificial procedural pages.
document_specific_visual_and_content_che: superseded versions visible but not operative
